svg.text: DWRPT_AI — Entity Relationship Diagram (Phase 0)
13 schemas · 108 tables · CommonClientID = universal cross-system identity key
CommonClientID present
joins via CommonClientID
clientdb (master registry)
ClientConsolidated
CommonClientId PK · DynamicsAccountId · ClientName · SiteUrl
→ authoritative client master; all other schemas join here
AI (query logging)
Log_Questions — AI query log; Question, Query, NaturalResponse
TotalInputTokensQuery/Response, TotalOutputTokens*
AppInterface, ViewName, ChartType, DatasetJson
Log_Questions_insights — insight annotations on queries
dynamics (CRM)
Account — accountid, name, das_3birdsid, city, state, websiteurl
CommonClientId FK → clientdb.ClientConsolidated
Account_Lookup — accountid, oems, ownername, CommonClientId
OptionSet · SalesOrderDetail (subscription billing)
radar (reputation)
clientConfigurations — commonClientID (text!), enabled, reviewsites
Reviews — ClientName, DateReviewIngested, StarRating,
ReviewSite, ReviewText, ResponseText, StatusOfReview
zuora (billing)
AccountStage — Id, AccountNumber, Name, Status, Currency
CrmId · ClientID → maps to CommonClientId
AccountingPeriodStage — fiscal year / period reference
Google (GMB)
DealershipDataFile — PlaceID, VDPImpressions, Calls
DASID → external dealer ID (no CommonClientID)
VehicleDataFile — VIN-level GMB VDP click data
CDXP / 3Birds Marketing (23 tables) — PII-bearing customer contact hub
CommonClientID on all tables · EmailAddress + PhoneNumber + PII on core tables
JuiceReporting_BlueSkyOverview — master contact table: ContactID, EDW_DMS_Customer_ID, CRMID,
email, name, address, zip, phone, LTVSegment, LeadSourceType, SaleDate, LeaseEndDate
JuiceReporting_Marketing_Summary — campaign sends, opens, clicks, unsubs per RecipientID
JuiceReporting_MatchBacks — campaign → sale/service attribution (SalesRevenue, ServiceRevenue)
JuiceReporting_LeadPerformance — lead source, conversion, CRMID, SaleDate
JuiceReporting_BSR_equity — VIN equity/trade-in valuation per contact
JuiceReporting_CDXPTransactionsOverview — revenue by campaign + transaction type
JuiceReporting_DataMiningTool — contact targeting with LTV score, last vehicle info
mv_contact_stats — contact-level attribution flags (attribution_sales, attribution_service)
ClientDetails — client address, phone, lat/lon, CIMFeedId · Juice_ZipCode_Geo — geo lookup
+ 14 more tables: HiddenTable_MarketingSummary, RecipientLoss, NEW_RECIPIENTS, BlueSkyCurrentLeads…
Key joins: JuiceReporting_BlueSkyOverview.RecipientID → Marketing_Summary.RecipientID
EDW_DMS_Customer_ID → core / RLData customer tables
core / Stage (30 tables) — Radar / survey / review staging
CommonClientId on Stage_Accounts, t_Reviews, t_Surveys
Stage_Accounts — account registry: Name, Token (GUID), CommonClientId, Deleted (soft-delete)
Stage_Review / Stage_Review2024 / Stage_Review4M — review ingestion by site + score
Stage_ReviewSentiment / Detail — AI sentiment labels (positive/negative/neutral + subtypes)
Stage_Surveys / SurveyResponse — NPS + rating surveys, sent date, VIN, email
Stage_SocialAdsCampaign — social ad campaign dates per account GUID
Stage_Txns / TxnTypes — transaction events linked to AccountToken
ReviewRocket* (6 tables) — review request workflow: config, sites, questions, survey, response, clicks
Stage_MRSReviewRequest / Notification — MRS review request pipeline
t_Reviews — denormalised review view: AccountName, CommonClientId, ReviewSite, score, date
t_Surveys — denormalised survey view: AccountName, CommonClientId, Type, NPSScore, Rating
Stage_Category / ReviewCategory — taxonomy for review classification
Key: Stage_Accounts.Token = ReviewRocket*.ClientId (GUID joins)
MLdata / MediaLogix (23 tables) — inventory + paid advertising
VehiclePerformanceDaily/V2: common_client_id · ML_Account_Info: common_client_id
FEEDADS / FEEDDEALERS / Listing / ListingVehicle — live inventory feed (VIN, price, make, model)
VDPPerformance / VDPVINPerformance — VDP impressions + clicks by VIN + account
PlatformAuto_Stats / Campaigns — PlatformAuto srp/vdp impressions + cost per dealer
grail_srpactions_daily / srpactions_daily — SRP action counts per listing/subscription
GVACampaignDataset / GVAVDPData / GVAVDPDatav2 — Google Vehicle Ads (GVA) performance
VehiclePerformanceDaily / V2 — meta_impressions + gpm_impressions per VIN per day
MLCommonClientIdMapping — acc_id → sales_channel_id + ref_id (cross-system mapping table)
ML_Account_Info — acc_id, common_client_id, sfdc_account_id, acc_company (master ML→CCI map)
__AllAdEzCampaigns / _AllFlights — campaign + flight price/status from AdEz
ImportLog — ETL import log per account; Display — display ad clicks/impressions/cost
LeadQueue — inbound lead queue: email, name, zip, phone, listing FK
RLData / Response Logix (10 tables) — lead response
customer — customer_id, name, website, status; AccountId + NewClientId FKs
franchise — franchise_id, customer_id, make_id, lead_crm, core_account_guid
lead — lead_id (GUID), lead_date, first, last, email, phone, zip, status, type
lead_history — history_date, type (lead lifecycle events)
make — make_id, name (vehicle make reference)
smart_facts_report_data / smart_follow_performance_report — RL performance reporting
reactivation — reactivation_id, email, reactivation_date
smart_quote — quote linked to lead_id (GUID)
ChatStatistics — lead_number, lead_date, customer_id, status
RPData / RocketChat+LiveJoin (3 tables)
Company — Id, Title, Type, Status, clientId
Leads — Id, CompanyId, ClientPhone, ClientEmail, Status,
CreatedAt, FirstName, LastName
Messages — Id, ConversationId, CompanyId, Type, Text, CreatedAt
No CommonClientID — join via clientId → clientdb
juice (consolidated reviews)
CommonClientId FK
Review — Id, ReviewSourceName, AccountName, CommonClientId,
ReviewSiteId, ReviewScore, ReviewerName, ReviewDate
Consolidated view across all review sources
LVData / LotVantage (5 tables)
youtube_settings — dealership_id, channel
youtube_videos — vehicle_id, dealership_id, url, external_id, status
youtube_video_stats / daily_stats — view counts by video + date
youtube_voice_recordings — vehicle_id, external_id, status
No CommonClientID — join via dealership_id
CDP Relevance Notes
• CommonClientID is the universal tenant key — present in 11/13 schemas. clientdb.ClientConsolidated is the authoritative master; all joins should route through it.
• PII exposure: CDXP.JuiceReporting_BlueSkyOverview holds name/email/phone/address — must be encrypted at rest in CDP ingest. GLBA-adjacent (tied to financing/equity).
• Identity resolution surface: CDXP has ContactID + RecipientID + EDW_DMS_Customer_ID + CRMID on the same row — richest cross-system identity signal in the estate.
• radar.clientConfigurations.commonClientID is typed as TEXT (not INT) — type mismatch with all other schemas. Requires cast or ETL coercion on ingest.
• MLdata.ML_Account_Info.common_client_id is VARCHAR(50) — same type mismatch. MLCommonClientIdMapping provides acc_id → channel + ref cross-walk for ML system joins.
• RPData (RocketChat/LiveJoin) and LVData (LotVantage/YouTube) have no CommonClientID — join to clientdb via clientId or dealership_id respectively.
• AI.Log_Questions tracks LLM usage (token counts, chart type, view name) — useful for CDP analytics product usage telemetry.
Generated 2026-06-14 · DAS Phase 0 Discovery · CONFLICT team · asalazar@weareconflict.com
